# AI Transformation Owner, Marketing

Company: Gitlab
Tracker ID: gitlab_ai_transformation_owner_marketing
Job ID: 8548105002
Location: Remote
Official URL: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/gitlab/jobs/8548105002

## Job Description

Own Marketing's AI transformation strategy from hypothesis and prioritization through working solutions, adoption, and measurable outcomes. Map end-to-end workflows, manage intake, establish governance, configure no-code and low-code AI agents, and partner with an AI Engineer on architecture and production delivery. Drive change management through office hours, onboarding, feedback loops, and a peer Champion network. Build schemas, validation, evaluations, and data flows while keeping human judgment at the right points. Experience with Marketing operations, AI workflows, product thinking, prompt engineering, agent configuration, and adoption is important.
